title: Soviet target-mice psi experiment in the Urals

tellings.quote: 12 and bottom 12 it was a perfect match all the bottom ones were controls all the top ones were Target mice

plain: A Soviet psychic research unit in the Ural Mountains ran an experiment with mice, and the results came out perfectly: "top 12 and bottom 12, it was a perfect match, all the bottom ones were controls, all the top ones were target mice." A former US Army psychic spy named Joe McMoneagle says he read this in a box of material from the Soviet unit. If true, it would mean the Soviets got a clean result showing a mental effect on living animals.
